_comment: Screenshots gallery for the /artwork/ page. Items with draft:true are admin-only visible until approved. Items with proposed:true are AppC pitch suggestions that don't have files captured yet — they show description-only cards in the admin draft queue until the file lands. Once the autoplay-capture pipeline ships, captured screenshots auto-append here with draft:true.

screenshots.title: Title screen — hero shot
screenshots.description: The Chronicles of Nesis title card with the windmill, hills, and clouds backdrop. Main menu (New Game / Continue / Options / Quit) overlaid. Captured 2026-06-04 from prod /play/. Captured at 1920x1080 viewport, 1270x920 native render.

screenshots.title: Options menu — settings UI
screenshots.description: Settings panel showing Music Volume, Sound Effect Volume, Fullscreen toggle, Difficulty selector, Controls, and Save. UI polish showcase, useful for marketing the depth of game configuration. Note: the small debug bar in top-left of these manual captures is dev-mode overlay; the autoplay pipeline should disable it before production captures.

screenshots.title: Cloud shadows over Laria — Main Square
screenshots.description: Recently-shipped cloud shadow feature over hill-mounted props. Hero shot of the parallax + lighting depth at golden-hour ambient.

screenshots.title: Windmill interior — multi-floor architecture
screenshots.description: Showcase the verticality of Windmill1 / Windmill1SecondFloor / Windmill1Basement together — environmental storytelling without UI overlay.

screenshots.title: WaterwayChannel — boss approach
screenshots.description: The atmospheric build-up just before the SluiceGate. Mood + foreshadowing rather than action.

screenshots.title: Skill Tree menu — full layout
screenshots.description: Hero shot of the Skill Tree UI showing the spatial layout of skills and progression structure. UI polish showcase rather than gameplay.
screenshots.blocked_on: Pending Autoplay — needs save-state with unlocked skill tree

screenshots.title: Poison status effect — visual overlay
screenshots.description: VSlime trail leaving poisoned terrain, showing the recently-shipped status effect system both in-combat and overworld.
screenshots.blocked_on: Pending Autoplay — needs combat with VSlime

screenshots.title: Character dialogue — Naphtali and Elias
screenshots.description: Glimpsed in the manual capture run: a dialogue / character-naming UI with 'Naphtali' and 'Elias' name boxes. Worth capturing properly when Autoplay can navigate the intro/dialogue flow cleanly without the menu overlay confusion.
